name: Descript
desc: Edit audio and video by editing the transcript text
desc_zh: 像改文字稿一样编辑音视频，代表了 AI 辅助创作的新交互范式
solves: Cutting a video means scrubbing a timeline frame by frame. Descript lets you cut by editing the transcript.
solves_zh: 剪视频要在时间轴上一帧帧拖。Descript 让你改文字稿来完成剪辑。
best_for: When you edit interviews, podcasts or talking-head video and know the words but not the frame numbers.
best_for_zh: 当你剪的是访谈、播客或口播视频，记得内容却不记得帧号。
